params.name: deposit_width
params.doc: How thick that ring is; narrow reads as a wire, wide as a disc.

params.name: deposit_arms
params.doc: How many arms the ring is broken into, as a whole number of arms; 0 leaves it whole.

params.name: deposit_twist
params.doc: Sweeps the arms into a spiral rather than leaving them radial.

params.name: deposit_spin
params.doc: Turns per second the deposited figure rotates by.

params.name: gamma
params.doc: Shapes the field's tone curve on its way out; below 1 lifts the mid tones.

params.name: wrap
params.doc: Wraps a sample that leaves the frame back in at the opposite edge, instead of clamping.

params.name: darken_center
params.doc: Pulls brightness down toward the middle of the frame.

params.name: brighten
params.doc: Lifts the field's bright end, MilkDrop's own brighten switch.

params.name: darken
params.doc: Pushes the field's dark end down, MilkDrop's own darken switch.

params.name: solarize
params.doc: Inverts the field above its midpoint, so highlights fold back into shadow.

params.name: invert
params.doc: Inverts the whole field.

params.name: echo_alpha
params.doc: How strongly a second, scaled copy of the field is blended over the first.

params.name: echo_zoom
params.doc: How much larger or smaller that echoed copy is.

params.name: echo_orient
params.doc: Which way the echoed copy is flipped before it is blended.

params.name: hue
params.doc: Where this scene reads from the palette, as a coordinate along it rather than a colour.

params.name: color_span
params.doc: How much of the palette the field's range covers.

params.name: color_center
params.doc: Shifts which part of that range lands in the middle of the palette.

params.name: saturation
params.doc: Pulls the scene's colour toward grey; 0 is fully desaturated, 1 is the palette's own.

params.name: palette_mix
params.doc: Crossfades from the preset's palette to its second one; 0 is the first, 1 the second.

params.name: palette_steps
params.doc: Quantizes the palette into this many flat bands; 0 leaves it continuous.

params.name: palette_contour
params.doc: Draws a line at each band edge when the palette is stepped; 0 draws none.

params.name: palette_contour_style
params.doc: Which line the contour draws: 0 a soft darkening, 1 a hard one, 2 a soft ink, 3 a hard ink.

params.name: palette_contour_ink
params.doc: Where along the palette an ink contour takes its colour; unread by the two black styles.

params.name: brightness
params.doc: The scene's overall light level, multiplying what it draws before the composite.

params.name: count
params.doc: How many elements are placed; 0 lets the layout decide. Truncated, so a rise admits its next element on arrival.

params.name: layout
params.doc: Picks which arrangement the elements are placed by.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Chooses one arrangement out of the family; the same seed always composes the same way. Truncated, like `count`.

params.name: size_hierarchy
params.doc: How much larger the leading elements are than the rest; 0 makes them equal.

params.name: angle_bias
params.doc: Degrees the elements lean by, which is what gives the composition its tilt.

params.name: roster
params.doc: Picks which set of shapes the elements are drawn from.

params.name: density
params.doc: How much of the frame the arrangement fills.

params.name: drift
params.doc: How far the elements wander from their placed positions.

params.name: spin
params.doc: Turns per second the elements rotate by.

params.name: recompose
params.doc: Crossing zero lays the composition out again from a new arrangement.

params.name: recompose_blend
params.doc: How long the change between two arrangements takes, rather than cutting.

params.name: pump_size
params.doc: Scales every element together, for a beat to make the whole composition breathe.

params.name: pump_alpha
params.doc: Fades every element together, the opacity twin of `pump_size`.

params.name: scale
params.doc: Size of the whole composition within the frame.

params.name: pan_x
params.doc: Slides the whole scene sideways, in the scene's own units rather than pixels.

params.name: pan_y
params.doc: Slides the whole scene vertically, in the scene's own units rather than pixels.

params.name: paper
params.doc: How opaque the ground behind the elements is; 0 leaves the backdrop showing.

params.name: color_span
params.doc: How much of the palette the elements are coloured across.

params.name: palette_shift
params.doc: Rotates every element's colour along the palette together.

params.name: saturation
params.doc: Pulls the scene's colour toward grey; 0 is fully desaturated, 1 is the palette's own.

params.name: palette_mix
params.doc: Crossfades from the preset's palette to its second one; 0 is the first, 1 the second.

params.name: opacity
params.doc: How opaque each element is, so overlaps can show through.

params.name: edge_softness
params.doc: How far each element's edge fades; 0 is a hard cut.

params.name: mode_n
params.doc: The plate's first mode number: how many nodal lines cross one axis. Equal to `mode_m`, the two waves cancel and the plate is blank.

params.name: mode_m
params.doc: The plate's second mode number: how many nodal lines cross the other axis.

params.name: line_width
params.doc: How wide a band around the nodal lines lights, in plate units (the plate is 2 across); 0 is a one-pixel line.

params.name: plate_mix
params.doc: Blends from the nodal lines alone toward the whole signed wave, which reads as a standing wave rather than as sand.

params.name: iterations
params.doc: How many steps an orbit is followed before it is called part of the set; more resolves finer boundary detail. Capped by the quality tier.

params.name: c_re
params.doc: The real part of the Julia constant: the lever that reshapes the set, from one connected piece to dust. Inert on the `mandelbrot` map.

params.name: c_im
params.doc: The imaginary part of the Julia constant. Inert on the `mandelbrot` map.

params.name: escape_radius
params.doc: How far an orbit must travel to count as escaped; larger smooths the colour bands' spacing.

params.name: power
params.doc: The exponent in z -> z^power + c: 2 is the classic set, higher whole powers add lobes, and a fractional power tears along the negative real axis.

params.name: interior
params.doc: How much light the set itself emits; 0 is the textbook black interior.

params.name: trap_radius
params.doc: How far the orbit trap sits from the origin — the circle's radius, the line's offset, the point's and the cross's distance. Inert with no `trap`.

params.name: trap_rotate
params.doc: Turns the orbit trap about the origin, in whole turns. Inert on a `circle` and with no `trap`.

params.name: color_span
params.doc: How much of the palette the field's level covers; 0 is one flat colour.

params.name: color_center
params.doc: Shifts which part of the palette the field's level starts from.

params.name: brightness
params.doc: The scene's overall light level, multiplying what it draws before the composite.

params.name: hue
params.doc: Where this scene reads from the palette, as a coordinate along it rather than a colour.

params.name: zoom
params.doc: Scales the whole scene about its centre; above 1 fills more of the frame.

params.name: pan_x
params.doc: Slides the whole scene sideways, in the scene's own units rather than pixels.

params.name: pan_y
params.doc: Slides the whole scene vertically, in the scene's own units rather than pixels.

params.name: saturation
params.doc: Pulls the scene's colour toward grey; 0 is fully desaturated, 1 is the palette's own.

params.name: palette_mix
params.doc: Crossfades from the preset's palette to its second one; 0 is the first, 1 the second.

params.name: palette_steps
params.doc: Quantizes the palette into this many flat bands; 0 leaves it continuous.

params.name: palette_contour
params.doc: Draws a line at each band edge when the palette is stepped; 0 draws none.

params.name: palette_contour_style
params.doc: Which line the contour draws: 0 a soft darkening, 1 a hard one, 2 a soft ink, 3 a hard ink.

params.name: palette_contour_ink
params.doc: Where along the palette an ink contour takes its colour; unread by the two black styles.

params.name: birth
params.doc: Which live-neighbour counts bring a dead cell to life, as a bitmask over the counts 0-8: bit k set means k neighbours give birth. 8 (bit 3) is Conway's.

params.name: survive
params.doc: Which live-neighbour counts keep a live cell alive, as a bitmask over the counts 0-8. 12 (bits 2 and 3) is Conway's.

params.name: radius
params.doc: How far the neighbourhood reaches, in cells: a square of side 2 x radius + 1 about each cell. Capped by the quality tier.

params.name: birth_lo
params.doc: The least filled fraction of its neighbourhood at which a dead cell is born.

params.name: birth_hi
params.doc: The most filled fraction of its neighbourhood at which a dead cell is born.

params.name: survive_lo
params.doc: The least filled fraction of its neighbourhood at which a live cell survives.

params.name: survive_hi
params.doc: The most filled fraction of its neighbourhood at which a live cell survives.

params.name: states
params.doc: How many colours the cycle holds; each cell advances to the next one round it.

params.name: threshold
params.doc: How many of its eight neighbours must already hold the next colour before a cell advances to it.

params.name: step_rate
params.doc: How many generations the automaton runs per second, whatever the frame rate; 0 freezes it.

params.name: reseed
params.doc: A rise past 0.5 refills one disc of the grid with fresh seeded cells, once per rise; bind a beat or a latch to it.

params.name: trail
params.doc: How many generations a dead cell keeps glowing, fading as it goes; 0 draws only the live cells.

params.name: age_tint
params.doc: How far along the palette a dead cell's glow travels as it fades; 0 keeps the wake the live cells' colour.

params.name: brightness
params.doc: The scene's overall light level, multiplying what it draws before the composite.

params.name: hue
params.doc: Where this scene reads from the palette, as a coordinate along it rather than a colour.

params.name: zoom
params.doc: Scales the whole scene about its centre; above 1 fills more of the frame.

params.name: pan_x
params.doc: Slides the whole scene sideways, in the scene's own units rather than pixels.

params.name: pan_y
params.doc: Slides the whole scene vertically, in the scene's own units rather than pixels.

params.name: saturation
params.doc: Pulls the scene's colour toward grey; 0 is fully desaturated, 1 is the palette's own.

params.name: palette_mix
params.doc: Crossfades from the preset's palette to its second one; 0 is the first, 1 the second.

params.name: palette_steps
params.doc: Quantizes the palette into this many flat bands; 0 leaves it continuous.

params.name: palette_contour
params.doc: Draws a line at each band edge when the palette is stepped; 0 draws none.

params.name: palette_contour_style
params.doc: Which line the contour draws: 0 a soft darkening, 1 a hard one, 2 a soft ink, 3 a hard ink.

params.name: palette_contour_ink
params.doc: Where along the palette an ink contour takes its colour; unread by the two black styles.

params.name: bg_hue
params.doc: Where the backdrop starts in the preset's palette, as a coordinate along it.

params.name: bg_bright
params.doc: How lit the backdrop is; 0 is black and the scene draws on nothing.

params.name: bg_vignette
params.doc: Darkens the backdrop toward the corners, pulling the eye to the middle.

params.name: bg_angle
params.doc: Direction the backdrop ramp runs in, in radians; 0 runs bottom to top.

params.name: bg_hue_span
params.doc: How far along the palette the ramp travels from `bg_hue`; 0 is a flat colour.

params.name: bg_shade
params.doc: Brightness multiplier at the ramp's start, so a sky can be dark at one edge.

params.name: bg_shade_end
params.doc: Brightness multiplier at the ramp's far end.

params.name: bg_ramp_gamma
params.doc: Bends the ramp's progress: below 1 the far colour arrives early, above 1 it holds off.

params.name: bg_band_amount
params.doc: Strength of a second colour band laid across the ramp; 0 removes it.

params.name: bg_band_angle
params.doc: Direction the band runs in, independently of the ramp, in radians.

params.name: bg_band_pos
params.doc: Where across the frame the band sits.

params.name: bg_band_width
params.doc: How wide the band is; narrow reads as a horizon, wide as a wash.

params.name: bg_band_curve
params.doc: Bows the band into an arc instead of a straight line.

params.name: bg_band_hue
params.doc: Where the band's own colour is picked from the palette.

params.name: bg_band_hue_span
params.doc: How far the band's colour travels along the palette across its width.

params.name: trails
params.doc: How much of the previous frame survives into this one; 0 is no trail, near 1 a long smear.

params.name: fb_zoom
params.doc: Scale the accumulation is grown by each second, so held above 1 the trail tunnels outward.

params.name: fb_rotate
params.doc: Turns per second the accumulation is rotated by, about the feedback centre.

params.name: fb_dx
params.doc: Sideways drift of the accumulation, in frame widths per second.

params.name: fb_dy
params.doc: Vertical drift of the accumulation, in frame heights per second.

params.name: fb_center_x
params.doc: The horizontal point the zoom and the rotation pivot about, in uv.

params.name: fb_center_y
params.doc: The vertical point the zoom and the rotation pivot about, in uv.

params.name: fb_warp
params.doc: Amplitude of a swirl added to the feedback sample, so the trail curls rather than sliding.

params.name: kaleido_order
params.doc: How many mirrored wedges the frame is folded into; 1 is no fold at all.

params.name: kaleido_angle
params.doc: Rotates the whole fold, in radians.

params.name: kaleido_center_x
params.doc: The horizontal point the wedges radiate from, in uv.

params.name: kaleido_center_y
params.doc: The vertical point the wedges radiate from, in uv.

params.name: kaleido_edge
params.doc: Softens the seam between mirrored wedges; 1 is a hard edge.

params.name: kaleido_tile
params.doc: Repeats the source across the frame before it is folded, so one wedge shows several copies.

params.name: kaleido_radial
params.doc: Scales distance from the centre when sampling, pulling detail inward or pushing it out.

params.name: kaleido_spiral
params.doc: Rotates the sample by an amount that grows with radius, turning the wedges into a spiral.

params.name: kaleido_zoom
params.doc: Shifts the sampled radius inward or outward, riding on the radial term.

params.name: kaleido_inner
params.doc: Radius of the untouched disc at the centre, which keeps the pivot from smearing.

params.name: bloom_amount
params.doc: How much of the blurred bright pass is added back; 0 turns the stage off entirely.

params.name: bloom_threshold
params.doc: The linear level a pixel must exceed before it glows at all; raise it to bloom only highlights.

params.name: bloom_radius
params.doc: Scales how far the glow spreads from the pixel that produced it.

params.name: occlude
params.doc: How much of the backdrop the scene's own coverage hides; 0 lets the sky through everywhere.

params.name: exposure
params.doc: Linear gain applied to the whole frame before the tonemap; 1 leaves it as rendered.

params.name: ink_amount
params.doc: How far the frame is remapped onto the paper-and-ink pair; 0 leaves it untouched.

params.name: paper_hue
params.doc: Hue of the colour an unlit pixel becomes, as a position around the wheel.

params.name: paper_sat
params.doc: Saturation of the paper colour; 0 is neutral.

params.name: paper_bright
params.doc: Brightness of the paper colour, which sets how light the empty ground reads.

params.name: ink_hue
params.doc: Hue of the colour a fully lit pixel becomes.

params.name: ink_sat
params.doc: Saturation of the ink colour; 0 is neutral.

params.name: ink_bright
params.doc: Brightness of the ink colour, which sets how dark the drawn marks read.

params.name: ink_gamma
params.doc: Shapes the paper-to-ink ramp: below 1 the mid tones bite earlier, above 1 they hold back.

tables.name: preset
tables.doc: The preset document: which scene it drives, what drives its parameters, and the structural tables that shape both.

keys.name: system
keys.doc: Which built-in scene this preset drives. Required.

keys.name: name
keys.doc: Human-readable name; absent means the system's own name.

keys.name: representative
keys.doc: Whether this preset is one of its family's samples for the narrowed test tier.

keys.name: params
keys.doc: One expression per named parameter; an unbound parameter keeps its default.

keys.name: per_vertex
keys.doc: Bindings evaluated once per mesh vertex, with x/y/rad/ang in scope.

keys.name: smoothing
keys.doc: Per-parameter easing in seconds; an unlisted parameter is applied instantly.

keys.name: hold
keys.doc: Per-parameter sample-and-hold; an unlisted parameter is read every frame.

keys.name: latch
keys.doc: Named armed-and-fired events an expression can read as a variable.

keys.name: curve
keys.doc: The parametric curve's family.

keys.name: generator
keys.doc: The L-system's grammar or the star pattern's tiling, plus the preset's seed.

keys.name: particles
keys.doc: The attractor family, its density, and what morph travels towards.

keys.name: path
keys.doc: An authored silhouette for the shape field, as inline SVG path data.

keys.name: spectrum
keys.doc: How the readout divides the frequency axis and what figure it forms.

keys.name: mesh
keys.doc: The warp mesh's grid, in cells.

keys.name: field
keys.doc: Which closed-form world the analytic field draws.

keys.name: cellular
keys.doc: Which automaton the cellular system runs, and on how large a grid.

keys.name: milk
keys.doc: A converted MilkDrop preset's compiled programs and shaders.

keys.name: feedback
keys.doc: Which warp the accumulation buffers resample their past through, and how this frame is deposited onto it.

keys.name: palette
keys.doc: The colour gradient; absent means the built-in spectrum.

keys.name: palette_b
keys.doc: The crossfade target a bindable palette_mix travels towards.

keys.name: occupancy
keys.doc: Parameters whose clamp bounds are meant to pin, exempted from the saturation gate.

keys.name: layer
keys.doc: A second scene drawn with the first.

tables.name: layer
tables.doc: A second scene drawn with the first, with its own system, bindings and structure.

keys.name: system
keys.doc: Which built-in scene the layer draws. Required.

keys.name: join
keys.doc: Where the layer joins: into the main scene's target, or into the chain as its own image.

keys.name: blend
keys.doc: How an over-joined layer blends into the chain. Inert on an under join.

keys.name: mix
keys.doc: The over junction's amount; absent means full strength.

keys.name: params
keys.doc: The layer's own parameter bindings, namespaced to its scene.

keys.name: per_vertex
keys.doc: The layer's per-vertex bindings, for a warp-mesh layer.

keys.name: smoothing
keys.doc: Per-parameter easing for the layer's bindings.

keys.name: hold
keys.doc: Per-parameter sample-and-hold for the layer's bindings.

keys.name: curve
keys.doc: The layer's parametric curve family.

keys.name: generator
keys.doc: The layer's L-system grammar or star tiling.

keys.name: particles
keys.doc: The layer's attractor family.

keys.name: path
keys.doc: The layer's authored silhouette.

keys.name: spectrum
keys.doc: The layer's readout configuration.

keys.name: mesh
keys.doc: The layer's warp-mesh grid.

keys.name: field
keys.doc: The layer's analytic-field family.

keys.name: cellular
keys.doc: The layer's automaton family and grid.

tables.name: latch
tables.doc: A gate armed on one condition and fired by the first rising edge of another inside the arming window.

keys.name: arm
keys.doc: While this holds above 0.5 the latch is armed; its fall re-arms it. Required.

keys.name: fire
keys.doc: The rising edge that fires an armed latch. Required.

keys.name: hold
keys.doc: How long the fired latch reads 1, in seconds. 0 is a single frame.

tables.name: curve
tables.doc: Which parametric family the curve scene samples.

keys.name: family
keys.doc: The curve family. Required.

tables.name: generator
tables.doc: The L-system's grammar or the star pattern's tiling, plus the salt every system's hash() and noise() mix in.

keys.name: axiom
keys.doc: L-system: the starting string. Required on an lsystem preset.

keys.name: rules
keys.doc: L-system: production rules, each key a single predecessor character.

keys.name: angle_deg
keys.doc: L-system: turn angle for + and -, in degrees.

keys.name: max_depth
keys.doc: L-system: how many iterations to expand and cache.

keys.name: seed
keys.doc: The salt hash() and noise() mix into their argument; "random" draws one per launch and pins to 0 on every capture path.

keys.name: tiling
keys.doc: Star pattern: the regular tiling the rosette is built on, or "none" for the ring ornament alone. Required on a star_pattern preset.

keys.name: contact_angle_deg
keys.doc: Star pattern: the contact angle the interlace is struck at, in degrees.

keys.name: rings
keys.doc: Star pattern: concentric rings of repeated motifs filling the interior.

tables.name: ring
tables.doc: One ring of repeated motifs inside a star rosette.

keys.name: motif
keys.doc: Which motif to repeat. Required.

keys.name: count
keys.doc: Copies around the ring. Required.

keys.name: radius
keys.doc: Distance from the frame centre to each copy's centre. Required.

keys.name: scale
keys.doc: Motif size multiplier.

keys.name: phase
keys.doc: Angular offset of copy 0, in radians.

tables.name: particles
tables.doc: Which strange attractor the compute-particle scene iterates, how much of the tier's budget it draws, and what morph travels towards.

keys.name: family
keys.doc: The attractor family: one of the four maps, or an IFS figure. Required.

keys.name: density
keys.doc: Fraction of the tier's particle budget actually drawn.

keys.name: morph_to
keys.doc: The IFS figure morph travels towards; absent pins the figure and makes morph inert. An error on a map family.

keys.name: tuple_from
keys.doc: Map families: the near end of the tuple path morph walks, as a roster index.

keys.name: tuple_to
keys.doc: Map families: the far end, and the key that turns the walk on. An error on an IFS figure.

tables.name: path
tables.doc: An authored silhouette for the shape field, as inline SVG path data.

keys.name: d
keys.doc: The contour, as SVG path data. Required.

keys.name: morph_to
keys.doc: A second silhouette morph travels towards; absent makes morph inert.

keys.name: samples
keys.doc: The arity both contours are resampled to, and what the per-pixel field costs O(N) in.

tables.name: spectrum
tables.doc: How the readout divides the frequency axis, what figure the elements form, and how fast each element follows its band.

keys.name: elements
keys.doc: Element count. A readout finer than the band array is refused.

keys.name: layout
keys.doc: Which figure the elements form.

keys.name: smoothing
keys.doc: Per-element easing in seconds, in the [smoothing] table's own vocabulary.

tables.name: mesh
tables.doc: The warp mesh's grid, in cells. Clamped to the tier at both consumers rather than at load.

keys.name: x
keys.doc: Cells across.

keys.name: y
keys.doc: Cells down.

tables.name: field
tables.doc: Which closed-form world the analytic field draws.

keys.name: family
keys.doc: The field family. Required inside the table; an absent table is chladni.

keys.name: map
keys.doc: Escape time only: julia iterates from the pixel with c the constant, mandelbrot makes the pixel c.

keys.name: trap
keys.doc: Escape time only: colour each pixel by how near its orbit came to this shape instead of by how fast it escaped.

tables.name: cellular
tables.doc: Which automaton the cellular system runs, on how large a grid, and whether its edges wrap.

keys.name: family
keys.doc: The automaton family.

keys.name: grid
keys.doc: Cells per side. A content value, not a resolution: doubling it halves how large every pattern looks.

keys.name: wrap
keys.doc: Whether the grid is a torus; false makes every cell past the border dead.

tables.name: milk
tables.doc: A converted MilkDrop preset's compiled programs, its two shaders, and the frame-level choices that ride with them. Produced by the converter, not hand-authored.

keys.name: per_frame_init
keys.doc: The once-at-load program, as assembly text.

keys.name: per_frame
keys.doc: The once-per-frame program, as assembly text.

keys.name: per_vertex
keys.doc: The once-per-mesh-vertex program, as assembly text.

keys.name: waves
keys.doc: The custom waves, each with its own programs.

keys.name: shapes
keys.doc: The custom shapes, each with its own programs.

keys.name: warp_shader
keys.doc: The emitted warp shader body.

keys.name: comp_shader
keys.doc: The emitted composite shader body.

keys.name: blur_level
keys.doc: How many blur levels the shaders sample, 0 to 3.

keys.name: quantize_steps
keys.doc: The warp field's quantization, in steps.

tables.name: milk_element
tables.doc: One custom wave or shape: its programs, how many instances it draws, and how it is stroked.

keys.name: init
keys.doc: The once-at-load program, as assembly text.

keys.name: per_frame
keys.doc: The once-per-frame program, as assembly text.

keys.name: per_point
keys.doc: The once-per-point program, as assembly text.

keys.name: count
keys.doc: Points along the element.

keys.name: instances
keys.doc: How many copies are drawn.

keys.name: use_dots
keys.doc: Draw points rather than a connected line.

keys.name: thick
keys.doc: Stroke at the thick width.

keys.name: additive
keys.doc: Add into the frame rather than blending over it.

tables.name: feedback
tables.doc: Which curated warp the accumulation buffers resample their past through, and how this frame's light is deposited onto it.

keys.name: warp
keys.doc: The warp the accumulation reads its previous frame through.

keys.name: blend
keys.doc: How this frame is deposited: bounded by the source maximum, or summed.

tables.name: occupancy
tables.doc: Parameters whose clamp bounds are meant to pin, exempted from the saturation gate. Harness-only; nothing per-frame reads it.

keys.name: exempt
keys.doc: Parameter names whose clamps may sit at their bound.

tables.name: palette
tables.doc: The colour gradient: a built-in name, or explicit stops. The two are mutually exclusive.

keys.name: name
keys.doc: A built-in gradient.

keys.name: stops
keys.doc: An explicit gradient, as positioned colours.

tables.name: stop
tables.doc: One gradient stop: where it sits, and what colour it is. Authored in sRGB.

keys.name: at
keys.doc: Position along the gradient, 0 to 1. Required.

keys.name: color
keys.doc: The colour, as #rrggbb or [r, g, b] in 0..1. Required.
